scope: offline extracted firmware; real getter, normalizer, interpolation; synthetic RAM state

axis.physical_units: vehicle speed km/h and raw/128 are corroborated inferences from native D5073 row labels plus speed-ratio producer; the export has no explicit row unit

interpolation.one_dimensional: unsigned, interpolate adjacent words with 12-bit fractional coordinate; truncate magnitude toward first endpoint
interpolation.high_endpoint: coordinate clamps at65535; a changing final segment approaches but need not exactly reach cell16
interpolation.two_dimensional: unsigned column-major; interpolate row within each adjacent column then interpolate columns; argument2=row, argument3=column

gear.source: A5+0x2250 committed into A5+0x2286 at0xC06E6; initial byte from0x14E21 at0xC0704
gear.interpretation: selected gear-state index, not proof of physically achieved gear
gear.column_reference: marker-confirmed native D5073-D5075 label index0..4 as1st..5th; alternate banks use same index without conversion

speed_fields.raw: 1202 derives from runtime122A and constants14B12,14B18(H0137),14B16(H0103), then factor60/16
speed_fields.network: 120A normally multiplies network word2122 by learned factor0B2E >>15, with fallback copy from120C; this report does not independently identify the network word

windows.title: row coordinate producer and family selector
selected gear index commit and initialization

limitations: No vehicle execution or physical input measurements.
Physical units use existing named-definition evidence; raw axis/interpolation are independently executed.
Gear producer commit is traced; all upstream candidate-gear selection paths were not traced.
Stock alternate vectors are constant65535, so synthetic emulator-only ramps expose interpolation behavior.
Bilinear replay uses a synthetic3x3 grid, not a claim about calibration14E48 meaning.
